text:
maria_p: Heads-up — product wants to flip v2 as the default for new tenants next week. We need a small playbook: telemetry sampling for compatibility regressions, console affordance for tenants to pin to v1, and clear quota accounting so billing isn't surprising.
alex_k: +1 on playbook. main concerns: (1) noise from deprecation alerts, (2) tenants accidentally charged at v2 perf tiers, (3) sticky session routing for pinning.
sam_r: For telemetry we should add a sampled 'compat_regression' signal tied to request traces. e.g. sample 1% by default and escalate to 10% for tenants that start failing evals more often.
jordan_l: How do we detect "failing evals" in prod without shipping tons of false positives? we need per-tenant eval sets or a prompt-seed set.
maria_p: Agreed. proposal: add a small invariant checkset (20 prompts) per tenant — run them on a shadow v2 run and compute a regression score. If score > threshold, raise compatibility alert and increase sample_rate.
alex_k: That works. Also need API header and console toggle for pin. Suggest header: `X-Redwood-Client-Version: 1` to force v1 routing, and console exposes a per-route pin button with 60-day default TTL.
sam_r: Example header: `curl -H "X-Redwood-Client-Version: v1" https://api.redwood.ai/generate` We'll route by precedence: explicit header > tenant pin > default routing policy.
jordan_l: Quota accounting question: if a tenant pins to v1, should they be charged the old unit cost or the new v2 cost? Sales asked that pinned v1 tenants not see surprise price increases.
maria_p: We agreed offline: billing follows the model variant actually served. But console should show an estimated cost delta when pinning (popup). ops asked for a "safety cap" flag to prevent pin from causing >X% sudden spend increase.
alex_k: Implementation notes: routing priority table modification + small API gate. We'll need to persist pin state in tenant routing config and make it part of the route decision path (fast path). Make sure read path is cached and invalidation TTL low (30s).
sam_r: Telemetry fields to add to logs: `client_version`, `route_pin_state`, `compat_sample_rate`, `shadow_regression_score`. Keep these as lightweight top-level tags (not big blobs) so index cost is low.
maria_p: Console UX: show banner on per-tenant overview: "Routing default is v2; X tenants pinned to v1". On the route page show pin toggle and estimated cost impact and last shadow regression score. Also add an audit log entry when pin toggled.
jordan_l: Rollout plan: 1) soft-flip default for 5% new tenants; 2) enable telemetry sampling and shadow checks; 3) expose console pin + cost estimate; 4) increase default to 50% if no major regressions; 5) full flip after 60 days.
alex_k: Danger: some clients send an older SDK that doesn't set client_version header. We'll need heuristics: if no header, infer from user-agent with coarse rules, but default to conservative (treat as unknown -> don't force v2). Also include a banner in console prompting tenants to upgrade SDK.
sam_r: For sampling config: central flag `compat_sample_rate_default=0.01` and per-tenant override key `compat_sample_rate_override`. We'll emit `compat_sample_rate` to telemetry on each sampled trace.
maria_p: Can eng-deploy-bot add a job to run the 20-check shadow suite nightly for pinned tenants? We want stale pins to be re-evaluated.
eng-deploy-bot: scheduled job created: `v2-shadow-checks` runs nightly, owners: eng-platform, alerts to #eng-platform-oncall if regression_score > 0.2 for 3 consecutive nights.
jordan_l: Edge-case: multi-region tenants with mixed pins. routing must be region-aware and respect local pin state. that adds complexity to the cache key.
alex_k: Proposed cache key: tenant_id + route_id + region + pin_version. pin_version is incremented on any pin change to invalidate easily.
maria_p: OK next steps: (a) alex/sam sketch routing + telemetry PRs, (b) jordan prototype console banner and pin UI copy, (c) product/legal confirm 60-day TTL and billing language, (d) add an experiment to flip default for 5% of new tenants tomorrow. Can we target M1?
alex_k: I'll open the routing PR today, will add TTL docs and cache key sketches.
sam_r: I'll add telemetry fields + sampling flag and a small mock of the shadow check harness.
jordan_l: I'll wire up a console mock and the cost estimate calc.
maria_p: Thanks team. If anyone hits a blocker, drop a quick note here. :thumbsup:
